name: comp-274
blurb: Bordered info alert with blue icon.
description: Info alert with visible border using a blue info icon. Provides more visual weight than inline info for section-level information display.
use_when: Displaying prominent informational content, help text, or notices that need visual distinction.
avoid_when: Minimal alert style. When borders conflict with design system.
a11y: No ARIA alert role. Icon hidden. Parent should add role='status' and aria-live for screen reader support.
